related.title: Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統
related.titleEn: Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組；Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統改以光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules; Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system centers on sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照單光子編碼與光子與時間模式，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Xanadu Aurora 模組光子量子系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以模組互連與解碼為起點，設計一項能區分「光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組」與「光子來源、多工、叢集態與即時解碼」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare single-photon encoding with photons and time modes and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Xanadu Aurora modular photonic quantum system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from module links and decoding and propose an observation distinguishing sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules from sources, multiplexing, cluster states and real-time decoding, including uncertainty.

practice: 對照單光子編碼與閘定義量子點，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以模組互連與解碼為起點，設計一項能區分「光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組」與「量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare single-photon encoding with gate-defined dots and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from module links and decoding and propose an observation distinguishing sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules from quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability, including uncertainty.

history.title: PsiQuantum Omega 融合式光子架構
history.text: Omega 公開架構連結晶片、封裝與機櫃；容錯及百萬位元為研發目標，課程不將路線圖當成已完成系統。

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型

history.text: 本課將光子來源、融合量測與可製造模組改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns sources, fusion measurements and manufacturable modules into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
